# Third-party Python supply notices

CPython 3.13.15 standard GIL distributions are downloaded from the pinned python-build-standalone 20260901 release, without patching upstream source.

- Release: https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/releases/tag/20260901
- Build source and upstream dependency source URLs: https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/tree/20260901
- Complete upstream source archive: https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/archive/refs/tags/20260901.tar.gz
- CPython source: https://www.python.org/downloads/release/python-31315/

The upstream license collection is reproduced in upstream-licenses. Its presence is a documentation closure check, not a claim of platform qualification or a complete redistribution review. Runtime binary licenses remain inside their downloaded distributions. Pillow 12.0.0 and NumPy 2.4.1 retain their wheel license files in each prepared environment; their consumer locks and notices are supplied with the respective skill/workflow.

No downloaded Python executable, venv, dependency wheel or user cache is bundled with the extension. The Windows runtime DLL redistribution conditions and final target-specific license audit remain release acceptance items until recorded in the OpenSpec implementation report.
